context: Interactive radial dendrogram with hierarchical edge bundling showing software module dependencies — a data visualization with tension slider and hover interaction
first_impression: Clean, well-proportioned radial layout with an intentional colorblind-safe palette, but the bundled edges form a murky gray mass at the center that obscures the dependency structure in the default state.
what_works: Deliberate use of the Tol colorblind-safe palette (not schemeCategory10) is a genuine design choice; the canvas+SVG hybrid architecture and adequate radial whitespace give the layout a considered, professional feel.
what_doesnt: The 80 edges at 0.25 opacity converge into an indistinct gray blob in the center — the data encoding is barely readable without hovering, which makes the idle state feel like noise rather than information; labels at 9.5px are borderline too small to read in the screenshot, especially on the left-side nodes.
